title: Continuous Local Infusion of Anesthetic at the Incisional Site for Scoliosis Surgery
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effects of continuous local anesthetic delivery on the immediate post-op recovery of patients undergoing spinal fusion surgery for congenital or idiopathic scoliosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical Diagnosis of Congenital Scoliosis
* Clinical Diagnosis of Idiopathic Scoliosis
* Anticipated Spinal Fusion Surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Less than 8 years of age
